name: Grand Hyatt Erawan Bangkok
positioning: Central Bangkok hotel next to the Erawan Shrine, with a resort-style spa and club retreat on its 5th floor
best_for: Travelers who want a base in central Bangkok's commercial district near the Skytrain
Guests who want a large spa, pool and sports retreat inside a city hotel

facts.text: The hotel sits in central Bangkok's key commercial and diplomatic district, next to the Erawan Shrine.
The hotel overlooks the Erawan Shrine, which is located just outside the hotel.
The Erawan Shrine houses the statue of Phra Phrom, the Hindu god of creation.
The Erawan Shrine is famous for bringing good fortune and attracts millions of visitors each year.
Ratchadamri BTS station and Chit Lom BTS Skytrain station are the nearby stations for getting around.
The hotel is directly adjacent to shopping at Siam Paragon, Siam Center and Siam Discovery.
The treatments at i.sawan are inspired by Thailand's ancient healing arts.
The Erawan Spa Cottages are a cluster of resort-style villa suites that all face gardens.
Rooms have a separate bathtub and walk-in rain shower.
24-hour butler service is available with select suites and upon request.
The hotel offers a Thai cooking class led by a Thai chef, followed by lunch at Erawan Tea Room.
The Magic Table is a dining experience led by The Clairvoyants, Thommy Ten and Amélie van Tass, using 3D projection mapping on each table.

highlights.text: On the 5th floor, i.sawan is a resort-style spa and club retreat within the hotel spanning 7,000 square metres.
i.sawan features residential spa cottages, treatment bungalows, a pool, a fitness centre, a tennis court and a squash court.
The Garden Villas are surrounded by lush greenery near the pool, with a private terrace and Grand Club access.
The Erawan Suite offers a living area, dining room, kitchen, gym and a spa-like bathroom.
The outdoor pool is surrounded by a teak sundeck and lush landscaping.

considerations.text: The Erawan Shrine just outside the hotel attracts millions of visitors each year, so the immediate surroundings are busy.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban location with high foot traffic.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
